title: Publications list for the UK Neuromorphic Centre
summary: This listing documents research outputs from 2025 and 2026 associated with a multidisciplinary centre. The page enumerates academic papers covering photonic neuromorphic processing, event-based sensing using infrared fibre-optics, optoelectronic RRAM programming, reservoir computing with VCSEL arrays, and optical dot-product multipliers. Authors include researchers such as Antonio Hurtado, Egor Manuylovich, and Natalia G. Berloff. The content serves as a discovery coordinate for publications rather than reporting specific project milestones or commercial deployments.
tldr: A publication list from the UK Neuromorphic Centre featuring 2025-2026 research on photonic neuromorphic systems and event-based sensing.
